name: iPhone P-015 BYOC Swift falsifiability: three source mutants, each caught by its clause's XCTest/XCUITest cases on macOS CI (runs 37550635267, 37550639954, 37550644692)
commandNote: Each mutant is one commit on a throwaway branch, parent 5f5394cffe5d887521126147c5e91e17bf56ce70 (papercup-rust-mobile origin/master). The commit changes exactly one Swift source file plus .github/workflows/ci.yml. The trimmed ci.yml runs only the 'iPhone release gate (iOS 26 SDK)' job. Its unit and UI xcodebuild test steps are continue-on-error, and a final verdict step echoes 'MUTATION_PROBE unit=<outcome> ui=<outcome>' and fails the job when either step failed, so job failure means the mutant was caught. The branches were built with git plumbing under a private GIT_INDEX_FILE (script: papercusp/.papercusp/scratch/p015-swift-mutants.py) and dispatched with workflow_dispatch --ref <branch>. The unmutated control is run 37535551821 (test_runs 20865284, docs/evidence/iphone-p015-xctest-ci-37535551821-2026-10-06.json), at 093238a51c16ccd1d09657474d9ad1478e61a176. git rev-parse shows that commit's ios/ tree is byte-identical to the mutant base's ios/ tree (e0cccf5d2c7075fb3667b5850172e90d5cb94642), and in that run every case below passed.
summary: All three P-015 Swift mutants were caught. offline-message (FriendlyError.swift matches 504 instead of 503) failed FriendlyErrorTests testCloudWorkspaceOfflineSaysTheCloudWorkspaceIsOffline, two ConnectionMonitorTests cases and the XCUITest testCloudWorkspaceOfflineThenRecoversWithoutRepairing. offline-recovery (ConnectionMonitor.swift keeps the offline state on a successful heartbeat) failed ConnectionMonitorTests testRelaySequenceWorkspaceOfflineThenBackReconnectsWithoutRepairing and the same XCUITest. relay-label (SettingsView.swift hides the relay row for a real relay pairing) failed only the XCUITest testCloudWorkspaceShowsRelayLabelInSettings. No run had a Swift compile error. In the unmutated control on the identical ios/ tree, every one of these cases passed.

mutants.mutation: isCloudWorkspaceOffline matches HTTP 504 instead of the relay's 503, so a workspace_offline refusal falls through to the generic error and the 'Desktop offline' banner
ConnState.next keeps the previous cloud-workspace-offline state on a successful heartbeat, so the app stays disconnected after the connector returns
SettingsView drops the 'Cloud workspace (relay)' connection row for a real relay pairing (condition requires an empty workspaceId) and falls back to the tunnel/LAN rows

assertions.evidence: git rev-parse 093238a:ios and 5f5394c:ios both return e0cccf5d2c7075fb3667b5850172e90d5cb94642. Control run 37535551821 (test_runs 20865284) passed every case listed below on that tree.
git diff --name-only <commit>^ <commit> lists exactly one Swift source plus .github/workflows/ci.yml for be343beb, 50aeefc4 and bbaa5ea2, and each parent is 5f5394cffe.
